results.title: First-24h heart rate per ICU stay
results.rationale: Filters chartevents (largest table) on itemid + stay_id + a charttime range. Without an index the planner must scan every chart event; a composite index in predicate order with INCLUDE(valuenum) allows an index-only range scan per stay.

results.title: Lab delta check (change from previous result)
results.rationale: The correlated subquery executes once per outer row (~10k), each doing an index probe plus top-1 sort over the patient's history. LAG() computes the same value in a single sorted pass.

results.rationale: The summary is requested repeatedly but changes only when data is reloaded. Materializing it moves the full scan, join and COUNT DISTINCT to refresh time.

results.title: Vital-sign counts per ICU stay
results.rationale: Five scalar subqueries per stay each scan chartevents (no index on stay_id), so the table is read hundreds of times. Conditional aggregation reads it once.

results.title: Distinct ICU stays per charted item
results.rationale: COUNT(DISTINCT) forces a sort-based aggregate per group and cannot use parallel or hash aggregation; de-duplicating with GROUP BY first can.
